column1: # This is the declared desktop and server baseline. It records the exact versions consumed
# by `bin/dotfiles/toolchain`; it is not an installer lockfile or an apply plan.
# Mise owns the selected Node, Bun, Python, Beads, and npm defaults. npm is
# explicitly subordinate to Node. The existing fnm, pyenv, and Homebrew
# runtimes remain live fallbacks until a separately authorized migration.
# `source_declared` means configuration exists but clean-machine qualification
# has not happened. It never proves exact reconstruction.
